title: Red Hat Security Advisory: pcp security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: A security update for Performance Co-Pilot (PCP) addresses a remote denial of service and information leakage vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-16530. PCP is a suite of tools for system-level performance measurement and analysis. The vulnerability has been rated with moderate severity by Red Hat Product Security. The update also includes bug fixes and enhancements unrelated to the security issue. The advisory applies to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 across multiple architectures.
